title: ci.yml: add permissions: contents: read (rust jobs run with default GITHUB_TOKEN)
description: Security review finding (mbzu pass-2): ci.yml has no permissions block, so all jobs run with the repo-default GITHUB_TOKEN; rust-build-test/clippy/all-features compile cloned external content (oscore-fork build.rs executes). Workflow never writes via the token. Fix: permissions: contents: read at workflow top level (or per-job) in ci.yml; check other workflows too.
